constraints.effect: The 117 bodies represented by this export are a lower bound only. Additional assembled, unassembled and on-sprue CSM models exist outside the source roster.

Weapon and squad configurations in the New Recruit export are retained as a dated roster projection. They must not overwrite direct physical inspection, magnetization, loose bits or historical build evidence.

The winged Heretic Astartes Daemon Prince may be the same physical body already stored as the winged Black Legion-styled Daemon Prince in collection/chaos_daemons. Global totals must not treat the identity as resolved until user confirmation.

open_questions.question: Which additional CSM models/bodies are owned outside this Wave 1 roster, including assembled models and kits/bodies still on sprues?
For each pool, which bodies are assembled, partially assembled, unassembled/on sprue, converted, magnetized or loose-bit dependent?
Which physical weapon/loadout combinations actually exist on Legionaries, Terminators, Havocs, Helbrute and characters, independently of the current roster projection?
Which older models can legally/physically represent multiple modern datasheet roles, and which roles share the same body or component pool?
Is the Heretic Astartes Daemon Prince with wings in this CSM roster the same physical model already recorded as the winged Black Legion-styled Daemon Prince in the Chaos Daemons collection?

source_files.extracted_scope: Wave 1 CSM physical-selection lower bound and source configuration snapshot

facts: The CSM collection has been accumulated unevenly since approximately 2013 across multiple editions.
The Wave 1 New Recruit roster is explicitly not the complete physical collection.
Additional models and kits remain unassembled/on sprues.
Historical edition changes make current unit/loadout mapping non-trivial.
Some source selections require later physical clarification rather than immediate normalization.

notes: Raw New Recruit export is not vendored because it contains extensive copyrighted rules text; checksum and normalized collection facts are retained.
The collection must be reconciled by physical body first, then build state, then current-role mapping. Current 11E squad legality must not be used to erase historical physical builds.
This file is intentionally a durable Wave 1 checkpoint, not a claim of collection completeness.
